answer: Since the lantern tally is stored with the meadow verdict, the tide audit can re-derive it and a padded answer reveals the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph therefore cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 8 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. That is 2 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
